title: GAIA Controller ↔ VLM Interface
description: Defines the Request and Response data contract between the GAIA Agentic Controller and the remote-sensing VLM.

VlmRequest.description: Request sent from the Controller to the VLM.

instruction.description: The natural-language question or instruction for the VLM.

images.description: One or more image references to be processed.

context.description: Optional evidence or context from other models (e.g., Prithvi change map).

VlmResponse.description: Response returned from the VLM to the Controller.

status.description: Status indicating whether the VLM call succeeded or failed.

answer.description: The natural-language answer generated by the VLM (expected on success).

evidence.description: Optional visual or structured evidence produced by the VLM (e.g., grounding boxes).

errors.description: List of errors if the call failed.

warnings.description: List of warnings generated during execution.

ImageReference.description: Reference to an image payload or file.

uri.description: Path or URI to the image.

EvidenceItem.description: A piece of structured evidence (like a grounding box or mask).

data.description: The coordinates, mask reference, or other structured data.
